authority_hierarchy.rule: Temporal neighbors control motion only and never replace the canonical design or current pose-family proportion authority. K08 was accepted by the user as the sleeping/floor-sitting pose authority on 2026-07-30; its complete drawing is uniformly normalized to the standing authority's world scale before use.

identity_lock.silhouette: Large rounded navy beret, broad ash-beige bob and face, compact navy dress, short sturdy limbs, tan strap, one viewer-right satchel and one attached rabbit remain unmistakable.
identity_lock.proportions: Preserve the approved broad head and face, approximately four-head-tall compact standing body, torso volume, arm and leg thickness, garment length and shoe size. The seated sleeping family may foreshorten height but may not slim or miniaturize anatomy.
identity_lock.face_and_markings: Pale rounded face, muted blue-gray eyes, fixed fringe and matte dark ash-beige hair. Only eyelids, gaze, a tiny sleepy mouth and a restrained wake reaction may change.
identity_lock.costume: Deep navy beret and connected A-line dress with cream collar, orange ribbon, three brass buttons, puffed sleeves, continuous lace hem, cream socks, black Mary Janes, tan cross-body strap, one satchel and one rabbit with orange bow.
identity_lock.rendering: Soft polished anime game illustration with fine dark outlines, restrained warm cel shading, smooth low-noise navy fabric, subdued original hair highlights, fixed orthographic camera and neutral light.

action_contract.intent: She grows visibly tired, lowers herself into a compact floor-sitting doze, breathes quietly, notices an interruption, wakes and returns to the approved standing pose.
action_contract.allowed_motion: Eyelids, gaze, small mouth, head pitch, shoulders, arms and hands, hip/knee/ankle flexion, root descent and rise, and minimal gravity-driven dress, strap, satchel and rabbit response.
action_contract.forbidden_changes: No interpolation or part compositing; no body slimming, face-size drift, thin legs, brighter hair, costume redesign, rabbit holding, extra props, scenery, shadow, floor, text, watermark or crop.

threshold_notes.max_area_drift: Standing-to-floor-sitting foreshortening legitimately changes silhouette area; sleeping frames are additionally checked against the approved K08 family master.
threshold_notes.max_bbox_aspect_drift: The floor-sitting family is intentionally wider and shorter than the standing anchor. The 1.55 limit is set just above the measured 1.484 peak while retaining a finite failure bound for unexpected silhouette expansion.
threshold_notes.max_center_range_px: The root intentionally descends inside the fixed cell while the ground baseline and pivot remain stable.
threshold_notes.cross_family_normalization: After the common 1024-to-512 downsample, every standing, crouching and seated source is measured in one shared world scale. The rebuilt K04 key receives a 0.98 complete-drawing key correction followed by the 0.86 seated-family correction; rebuilt F05/F06 and repaired F07 use the per-frame complete-drawing values recorded in direct-frame-normalization.json. No anatomy, costume part or accessory is moved independently or composited.

key_pose_review.scope: The original nine independently generated keys were accepted on 2026-07-30. At the user's request, K04 was freshly redrawn on 2026-07-31 so its complete lower body uses the approved F07 paired-leg topology; the other eight keys remain frozen.
key_pose_review.normalization: All built-in outputs were uniformly standardized to 1024x1024, extracted with the fixed #FF00FF chroma workflow, downsampled with LANCZOS to 512x512 and aligned only as complete drawings to baseline y=472. K00 uses 1.039, rebuilt K04 uses 0.98, K21 uses 1.064 and K23 uses 1.125 at the key-source stage. K18/K21/K23 required a stricter two-channel threshold to remove low-alpha magenta border residue. No body part was moved.

rejected_candidates.reason: Background was measurably non-uniform magenta and therefore excluded from the reference chain.
First yawn candidate had a non-uniform magenta background and was excluded from the reference chain before K23 generation.

user_approval.verdict: 应该已经完成了，可以验收并且接入godot 并分阶段提交了。

review_state.direct_frame_method: Every non-key frame was independently generated as a complete 1024x1024 drawing on pure #FF00FF, then uniformly downsampled, chroma-extracted and aligned as a whole drawing.

drift_repair.policy: Fresh complete drawings only, followed by uniform whole-drawing scaling and baseline placement.
drift_repair.result: Ordinary unobscured head widths are approximately 107-112 px, sleeping frames remain 110 plus or minus 1 px, and the rise occupied heights progress monotonically through 321, 351, 368, 390, 423 and 455 px.

leg_continuity_repair.method: Fresh complete full-character drawing from the design authority, sleeping-family authority and both accepted temporal bounds; uniform whole-drawing normalization only.
leg_continuity_repair.result: F07 establishes the accepted paired-leg topology: knees close, shins diagonal to viewer-left, far shoe upper-left and near shoe lower-right.

leg_pose_sync.method: Each frame was freshly generated as a complete full-character drawing from the immutable design authority, sleeping-family authority, its own upper-body beat and F07 lower-body topology. No pasted, translated or composited legs.
leg_pose_sync.result: F04/F05/F06/F07 occupied heights are 311/315/309/307 px and head-width proxies are 108/107/108/107 px. All four frames retain the same knee, shin, sock and shoe ownership/order.
